title: Dil Daar: The Arya
desc: After getting hired, Aadhavan, a professional assassin, infiltrates the house of a judge and hatches a plot to kill his target.

title: Naach Lucky Naach
desc: Ten-year-old Lakshmi dreams of winning a national-level dance competition, but she hesitates to participate when her single mother, Nandini, detests music and dance.

title: Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai
desc: An accident brings Karan and Pooja close to each other. When Karan finally decides to propose to her, he realises that destiny has other plans for them.

title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A matchmaker gets insulted by a rich and arrogant businessman. Later, he decides to take a revenge against the businessman by making his daughter fall in love with a porter.

title: Navarathna
desc: Moksha, a photographer, finds an ancient necklace that brings ill fate to those who wear it. Under the guise of capturing rare birds, she goes into a forest and plans to dispose of the ornament.

title: Police Power
desc: A police officer tries to change his younger brother, who turns to a life of crime, but he fails. He then takes on the local gangster responsible for inciting youngsters towards crime.
